description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the LDAPUser class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It tests setting various properties of LDAPUser instances, including optional lookup settings and mappings, and verifies their serialized output against expected hex strings.

classes.name: LDAPUserTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the functionality and serialization of LDAPUser objects, including setting attributes and incorporating lookup settings and mappings.

methods.name: testLDAPUser
methods.description: Tests setting basic attributes of LDAPUser and verifies their serialized output matches expected value.

methods.name: testLDAPUserWithLookupSetting
methods.description: Tests setting LDAPUser attributes along with a lookup setting that includes employee selector mapping, verifying serialized output accuracy.
